option.hyperstyle.hud_mode.tooltip: DEFAULT means hide when unranked, show otherwise
option.hyperstyle.hud_offset_right.toolt: How far the HUD is from the right edge of the screen. Higher value moves it to the left.
option.hyperstyle.hud_offset_top.tooltip: How far the HUD is from the top edge of the screen. Higher value moves it down.
option.hyperstyle.hud_scale.tooltip: Size of the style meter. 100% is the default size.
option.hyperstyle.hud_rotation.tooltip: Rotation of the style meter in depth, in degrees. ~0° is flat.
